newsitem.title: UK: Barclays gains after upbeat presentation.
newsitem.headline: Barclays gains after upbeat presentation.

text.p: Shares in Barclays Plc advanced on Tuesday following a company presentation for fund managers hosted by Kleinwort Benson on Monday and as analysts at the brokerage repeated their positive stance on the bank's shares.
Barclays shares were up 8p at 973-1/2p by 1543 GMT.

Market sources said analysts at Kleinwort Benson were particularly impressed by the banking group's performance in the credit card market, repeating their positive stance on Barclays today in a review of the UK credit card market.
The sources said they expect the shares to reach levels of around 11.20-11.40 stg by the end of next year.

"Margins are robust and their credit card business is a growing part of the banking group," said one source. "Barclaycard is the quality credit card in the UK market and the view is that its growth has been incredible and is probably underestimated."
Analysts at Kleinwort's were not thought to have upgraded their profit forecasts.
Barclay's chief executive Martin Taylor met with selective institutions Monday to discuss his broad strategy for the banking group's future growth.

"The view is that he was incredibly open and refreshing in his promotion and attitude and will make Barclays a less guarded institution," said the source, referring to the bank's relations with the financial community.
